title: Microbatch interleaver and KV primer: conditional prefetch to reduce prefill stalls
author: Elliot Ramos
release_notes: Reduced end-to-end tail latency for mixed-length workloads by introducing a microbatch interleaving scheduler and KV primer hints; enabled behind opt-in config microbatch_interleaver.enabled= true; no API changes.
description:
Motivation: Prefill-heavy workloads still exhibit GPU stalls when large prefill windows block decode progress for shorter requests. Existing speculative approaches either overfetch KV state or serialize stages too conservatively, wasting throughput. This change introduces two coordinated mechanisms: (1) a microbatch interleaver scheduler that interleaves small prefill microbatches with decode work to reduce idle GPU time, and (2) a KV primer hint that conditionally prefetches KV entries only for sequences predicted to need them soon. The design balances latency and memory pressure and is configurable per-route.

What this PR does (single-line continuous description): Adds Scheduler::MicrobatchInterleaver, an interleaving policy that slices prefill windows into microbatches and opportunistically schedules decode kernels between slices; introduces kv_primer hint propagation from request admission through scheduling to the runtime kernel selector; implements a predictive prefetch heuristic (sequence-length + remaining budget) that gates KV priming; introduces guards to limit concurrent primer memory usage; updates runtime kernel selection to accept primer hints and avoid eager KV expansion for low-probability sequences.

Commits summary: [commit 1] introduce microbatch interleaver scheduler and unit tests; [commit 2] add kv_primer hint plumbing and API surface; [commit 3] predicitive prefetch heuristic and memory guard; [commit 4] runtime kernel changes to honor primer hints and avoid eager KV expansion; [commit 5] integration tests and perf canary config; [commit 6] address reviewer feedback and add stress test for memory regression.

Files/areas changed (high level): src/scheduler/microbatch_interleaver.cc/h, src/scheduler/policy_registry.cc, src/runtime/kernel_selector.cc, src/runtime/kv_primer.cc/h, src/serving/route_config.cc (new per-route config flags), integrations/perf/canaries/microbatch-interleaver.yaml, tests/scheduler/microbatch_interleaver_test.cc, tests/runtime/kv_primer_integration_test.cc. Small edits: docs/observability.md (added notes about new per-route metric microbatch.interleave.ratio) and examples/quickstarts/microbatch-config.yaml.

Backward compatibility and flags: Feature guarded behind runtime config microbatch_interleaver.enabled (default: false). KV primer is off by default and enabled via route-level config kv_primer.mode = "conditional". No changes to public API or client SDKs. Migration: operators can flip the flags and tune microbatch_interleaver.max_microbatch_tokens and kv_primer.memory_limit_mb.

Performance results: Internal perf canary on T4-like nodes with mixed workloads (60% short requests <= 32 tokens, 40% long prefill requests) showed: p50 generation latency -7%, p95 -12% on mixed traffic; effective throughput increased ~8% for the same GPU pool; small memory increase at peak when kv_primer enabled (+4% RSS) but within configured limits. Deterministic unit tests added and integration stress harness to detect KV memory regressions.

Testing: Unit tests for scheduler heuristics and priority inversion cases; integration tests simulating interleaved prefill/decode streams; added perf canary (microbatch-interleaver) which runs nightly and reports microbatch.interleave.ratio and kv_primer.hit_rate. CI: all checks green after rerun (one flaky test in mem-monitor was retried and passed).

Review conversation (selected entries): Reviewer Aisha: "Can we make the heuristic more conservative when route concurrency is high? I saw a spike in RSS on one run." Author: "Added kv_primer.memory_limit_mb and conservative scaling based on concurrency; tests included in last commit." Reviewer Marta: "Please add a fallback to disable interleaving for very large prefill batches to avoid excessive kernel churn." Author: "Added microbatch_interleaver.max_microbatch_slices and early-exit if slice_count > 16; documented in route_config." Reviewer Ravi: "Nit: rename primer -> kv_primer for clarity in logs." Author: "Renamed; updated metrics and docs." Reviewer Aisha (approve): "Looks good after memory guard and test additions." CI bot: "mem-monitor flaky; rerun job passed."

Known limitations and follow-ups: The sequence-length predictor is simple (based on prompt length + model-specific token ratio) — follow-up ENG-4689 will explore a learned predictor and cross-request batching hints. Also plan to add a telemetry-driven autoscaler that adjusts the microbatch slice size based on observed interleave ratio.

Security and telemetry: No new surface for customer data; kv_primer only touches model-internal KV entries and does not persist customer data. Added microbatch.interleave.ratio and kv_primer.hit_rate metrics to help ops tune configs.

Merge: Squash-merged into main after approvals and CI green. Merged-at: 2026-03-02.
